note: The main banks, chosen as the best-known large card issuers (no central bank ranking was read): Bank Islam Brunei Darussalam, Baiduri Bank and Standard Chartered Brunei; only Baiduri Bank's tariffs, already found, were read again this time, for want of the research's budget. Baiduri Bank's general tariffs for personal accounts (rates last updated 15 October 2025), its credit card section, read in full on 2026-10-30 (first read 2026-10-29 for the Visa Classic alone): every Visa and Mastercard credit card is written with its principal card's annual fee (Visa Infinite 380, Platinum 280, Classic 40 Brunei dollars; Smart Executive Platinum free; Royal Brunei Visa Infinite 300 and Visa Platinum 200, each waived for its first 4 years; Mastercard Platinum 280, Classic 40); a financial charge of 1.5% a month on the outstanding balance; a cash advance fee of 3%, at least 10 dollars, plus 1.5% a month from the date of the advance; a late payment fee of 35 dollars a month; an over-limit fee of 15 dollars each time; a returned cheque or payment order fee of 100 dollars; and a 2% fee on foreign currency conversion. The tariff states no minimum payment or grace period. The Visa Classic was first written as 'Visa Credit Classic', the name kept.
